KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi Ngano za mtanziko, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi Ngano za mtanziko.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi Ngano za mtanziko.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi Ngano za mtanziko.

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
